title: Coding and Robotics Trainer
jobDescription: About WizKlub WizKlub is an innovation-driven education platform dedicated to building essential future skills in students from K–9. Our research-based programs focus on developing logical reasoning, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities through technology (coding and robotics), along with applied mathematics and science. These skills are crucial not only for academic success but also for excelling in competitive exams and future careers. At WizKlub, our mission is to empower 10 million young minds with the ability to solve real world problems and shape the future. Our structured methodology ensures holistic skill development, preparing students for a technology-driven world. Role: Coding and Robotics Instructor As a Coding and Robotics Instructor at WizKlub, you will be responsible for delivering high quality learning experiences to students in partnered schools while ensuring effective program execution and stakeholder engagement. Location : Ambur, Erode, Trichy, Pollachi, Coimbatore Chetty Street, Pondicherry Key Responsibilities 1. Program Delivery • Ensure timely completion of structured program deliverables. • Deliver engaging sessions on coding, robotics, and problem-solving concepts. • Introduce students to fundamental programming concepts, algorithms, and logical thinking. • Encourage participation in coding projects, hackathons, and robotics competitions. • Foster a creative, collaborative, and interactive learning environment. 2. School Coordination & Representation • Actively represent WizKlub at partner school locations. • Adhere to school timings, calendar, and assigned schedules. • Plan and coordinate sessions in advance to ensure smooth execution. 3. Student Management & Training • Maintain student records including attendance and progress. • Ensure clarity and preparedness in lesson plans before sessions. • Stay updated with WizKlub curriculum, platforms, and hardware. • Complete required instructor certifications and training programs. 4. Reporting & Documentation • Maintain accurate attendance and session records. • Provide timely updates to both WizKlub and school stakeholders. • Track and document student performance consistently. • Ensure proper reporting of overall program execution. 5. Student Performance & Assessment • Monitor and record student scores after each session. • Prepare and share monthly performance reports. • Update and distribute progress cards to students and parents. 6. Stakeholder Communication & Engagement • Communicate regularly with parents, school authorities, and internal teams. • Participate in Parent-Teacher Meetings (PTMs). • Conduct orientations for students and parents. • Represent WizKlub in school events, expos, and competitions. • Address and escalate challenges for timely resolution. 7. Business Contribution • Contribute to overall business growth through improved student outcomes and engagement. Compensation, Work Schedule & Timings • Compensation: o Full-Time: ₹3.26 LPA Fixed + ₹24,000 Variable o Part-Time: ₹20,000 per month (₹2.4 LPA) • Work Schedule: o Full-Time: Monday to Saturday o Part-Time: 4 days per week • Work Timings: o 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM

title: Area Sales Manager
jobDescription: About the Role You will be responsible for managing the business of a defined territory. The role involves acquiring new academic institutions, retaining and growing existing customers, and working closely with channel partners. You will engage with both schools and learners to drive adoption, usage, and revenue growth for Wizklub’s programs. This is a high-ownership, field-intensive role requiring strong relationship management, execution discipline, and problem-solving skills. About Wizklub Wizklub, a part of Infinity Learn (backed by the Sri Chaitanya Education Group) , is a leading K–12 learning solutions company focused on building future-ready skills among school students. Wizklub was acquired by Infinity Learn to strengthen its schoolintegrated offerings and to expand its footprint across the K-12 education ecosystem in India. Wizklub partners with hundreds of schools across multiple states, working closely with school leadership, teachers, and students to deliver curriculum-aligned programs in Coding, Robotics, and Higher Order Thinking Skills (HOTS). Through a combination of structured curriculum, hands-on learning through Futurz Lab, assessments, and teacher enablement, Wizklub helps students build conceptual clarity, logical reasoning, creativity, and confidence at an early age. With a strong pan-India presence, Wizklub’s programs are designed to integrate seamlessly into school schedules while delivering measurable learning outcomes. The company leverages technology, academic rigor, and on-ground execution to support schools in preparing students for future academic and career success. Infinity Learn, backed by the Sri Chaitanya Education Group , is transforming the digital learning landscape with a digital-first approach and industry-leading talent. Infinity Learn’s products focus on supporting K-12 students in building the right temperament, academic depth, and exam readiness for JEE, NEET, and Foundation courses, enabling learners to achieve their academic goals at scale. Wizklub: https://www.wizklub.com Infinity Learn: https://infinitylearn.comWatch our story on Disney Hotstar: https://tinyurl.com/8ee8p2sv Scope of the Role Customer Acquisition Own a defined territory and acquire new school customers. Pitch Wizklub programs to school leadership and decision-makers. Demonstration of Robotics Kit and the Coding Program to School Management Customer Retention & Upsell Retain existing partner schools. Drive upgrades and increase business value within the assigned portfolio. Marketing & Activation • Plan, organize, and execute marketing initiatives, demos, workshops, and student activation activities within the territory. Channel Development Identify, develop, and manage channel partners who can generate leads or influence sales. Build long-term, productive channel relationships. Collections Ensure timely collection of payments from schools and channel partners as per agreed terms. Customer Relationship Management Build and deepen relationships with school stakeholders. Conduct regular school visits and maintain strong engagement post sign-up. Customer Satisfaction & Problem Solving Capture and communicate customer feedback transparently. Proactively resolve issues related to program delivery, operations, or engagement. Monitor implementation progress and ensure timely resolution of challenges. Documentation Complete all required documentation related to school onboarding. Ensure advance collections as per company policy and compliance requirements. Reporting Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in CRM and reporting tools on a daily basis. Qualifications & Experience B.Tech in Computer Science (CS) / Electronics & Telecommunication (E&TC) Or BCA / MCA 2–8 years of B2B selling experience , preferably in education, edtech, or institutional sales Strong communication, stakeholder management, and execution skills Work Environment • High-energy, target-driven role • 100% field-based • 6 days a week working • Extensive travel within the assigned territory
